title_zh: 决定保留手工礼盒上的朴素设计

scenario.label_zh: 为手工作品确定最后的装饰
scenario.goal_zh: 讨论制作体验和送礼心意并决定保留现有设计

context_zh: 手工课学员莉娜给姐姐制作了一个小礼盒，临下课时请老师帕维尔看成品。
author: author-phase07-b

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: This is my first attempt at a craft since school. I expected a much neater box.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: The lid fits, and your painted leaves work well. Are you unhappy with the colours?

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: No, but there's a lot of empty space. Maybe my creation needs more decoration.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: Creativity isn't only about adding things. Leaving some space can be a choice too.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: My sister likes simple designs. She'd probably be delighted with it as it is.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: Then why not stop here? You've made something that suits her.

sentences.speaker: Lena
sentences.text: I will. Making a gift for her has been a real delight, even with all the glue on my fingers.

sentences.speaker: Pavel
sentences.text: Let it dry on the shelf, and you can take it home at the end of class.

targets.sense_zh: 令人愉快的事情或体验
